scope: Difficulty 0: 8 professions × 4 paired seeds = 64 runs; difficulty 3: 8 professions × 2 paired seeds = 32 runs; 96 full runs total.
method: Paired deterministic seeds beta19-${profession}-${index}-d${difficulty}, same route/combat policy as v21 audit, and same v19 candidateFit acquisition heuristic. JSON roundtrip after each action; acquisition gates and wrapper dispatch checked for both versions. Per-act reports include battle outcomes, total raw enemy attack damage per attack turn (including all hits), packet average, and observed net player HP loss across actions after defense. V22 additionally reports engine attackHpLost, petAbsorbed, and burnHpLost metric deltas. V21 incoming values are reconstructed estimates from executed end-turn intent and observed attacksTaken packet deltas, not engine-measured totals; HP loss is observed as positive per-action HP deltas, so healing within a compound action can offset damage. Furnace broken counts track state transitions; response event counter is unavailable in this completed sample due to an audit instrumentation path error; the script now counts execution from battle.intent.responseLocked.
limitations: Small deterministic policy sample, not human-play balance evidence. Encounter selection is random from actual route pools; rarity coverage is reported explicitly. Runs stop at a 600-action bound. V21 has no attack-specific loss metrics, so cross-version defense comparisons use observed net HP loss; V22 component metrics are extra diagnostics, not directly paired equivalents. Pre-tuning results are retained only as compact summary and class clears; no duplicate combat traces. V21 raw incoming damage is not exact and must not be compared numerically with v22 engine totals.
